settings.title: WhatsApp
settings.description: Send and receive WhatsApp messages with your customers.

enable.label: Enable WhatsApp
enable.hint: Turn on once your provider credentials are in place.

provider.label: Provider
provider.hint: Who supplies your WhatsApp number. Switching keeps the credentials of the old one.

from.label: Your WhatsApp number
from.hint: The business number customers see, in international format.

webhook.label: Webhook URL
webhook.description: Paste this into your provider so incoming messages reach Torqvoice.

template.title: Message template
template.description: Used when you write to a customer who has not messaged you recently.
template.windowExplainer: WhatsApp only allows free text for 24 hours after the customer's last message. Outside that window your message has to go out as a template approved by your provider.
template.nameHint: The approved template's name, or its Content SID at providers that use one.
template.languageHint: The language code the template was approved under, for example de.

test.title: Test and disconnect
test.description: Send a message to your own number to check the setup.
test.failed: Could not send the test message
test.hint: Message yourself on WhatsApp first, otherwise the test needs an approved template.

disconnect.hint: Removes the credentials from Torqvoice. Your conversations are kept.

messages.featureDescription: Send and receive WhatsApp messages, including photos of parts, directly from Torqvoice.
messages.noThreadsHint: Messages appear here as soon as a customer writes to your WhatsApp number, or you write to them.
messages.sentAsTemplateNotice: Sent as your approved template, because the customer has not written in the last 24 hours.
messages.windowClosed: The customer has not written in the last 24 hours, so this will go out as your approved template.
messages.unknownNumber: This number belongs to no customer yet. Add them as a customer to reply.

notConfigured.title: WhatsApp is not connected
notConfigured.description: Connect a WhatsApp number to send and receive messages with your customers.

messages.title: Conversations

compose.title: New WhatsApp message
compose.noRecipients: No customers with a phone number yet.

messages.windowBlocked: This customer has not written in the last 24 hours, so WhatsApp will not deliver a message right now. Ask them to send you one, or set up an approved template.
messages.windowBlockedPlaceholder: Waiting for the customer to write first

sendPhoto.title: Send photo on WhatsApp
sendPhoto.description: The customer gets this photo in their WhatsApp chat.
sendPhoto.captionPlaceholder: Add a note, for example what the photo shows
sendPhoto.sentAsTemplate: Photo sent as your approved template
